meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按任务挑选执行、指挥、评审三类角色智能体组成团队，让它们共享同一份上下文与决策记录，并把从讨论、辩论到形成结论的过程展示出来。
howto.when: 当你需要多个智能体协同完成复杂任务，或提到组建团队、技术架构决策、OPC 系统构建等场景时触发。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: 会展示主持人引导的辩论与共识过程

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略、产品架构、自动化工程三步输出

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 从市场分析、成本核算到定价结论

howto.what_en: Claude assembles a team of execution, command and review agents for your task, shares one context and decision history across them, and shows their discussion, debate and final conclusions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs several agents working together, or when you mention building a team, technical architecture decisions, OPC system building and similar scenarios.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to evaluate the microservice architecture
say_en.note: Shows the host-led debate and consensus

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos
say_en.note: Outputs strategy, product design, then automation

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product
say_en.note: Market analysis, cost check, then pricing
